entry.title: Awesome Home Assistant Updates on Sep 30 - Oct 06, 2019
entry.content:
In case you need help / 🤝 Official Communities

  • Home Assistant Discord - Join the chat, most of us are there.
  • Home Assistant Community - The community discussion forum.
  • Home Assistant Subreddit - If you are into Reddit, subscribe.

In case you need help / 🌐 Other Communities

  • Dr. ZZs - Facebook group by Dr. Zzs.
  • ESPHome Discord - Get support for your DIY ESPHome project.

Public Configurations / 🌐 Other Communities

  • Carlo Costanzo (⭐5.1k) - Probably the most documented configuration out there (5,147★).
  • DubhAd (⭐686) - Also known as Tinkerer, shares his configuration files (686★).
  • geekofweek (⭐1.5k) - Has 300+ automations (1,472★).
  • Alok Saboo (⭐2k) - Also known as arsaboo. Regularly updated (1,953★).
  • Franck Nijhof (⭐2k) - Home Assistant OS based, very different configuration structure compared to others (1,999★).

Custom Integrations / 💡 Lighting

  • Circadian Lighting (⭐882) - Slowly synchronizes your color-changing lights with the naturally occurring color temperature of the sky throughout the day (882★).

Custom Integrations / 📹 Cameras & video

  • HASS Aarlo (⭐466) - Asynchronous Arlo integration. Similar to the Arlo web site; monitors events and states for all base stations, cameras and doorbells (466★).

Custom Integrations / 📍 Presence & location

  • iCloud3 (⭐835) - Improved version of the iCloud device tracker component with a lot of capabilities (835★).

Custom Integrations / 🏷️ Vendor & brand

  • SmartIR (⭐2.7k) - Integrates devices using Broadlink IR (2,698★).

Custom Integrations / 📊 Logging & analytics

  • Elasticsearch (⭐164) - Publishes events to Elasticsearch (164★).

Dashboard Cards / 📈 Charts & graphs

  • Mini Graph Card (⭐3.8k) - A minimalistic sensor graph card (3,810★).
  • Canvas Gauge Card (⭐216) - Use awesome gauges from canvas-gauges.com (216★).

Dashboard Cards / 📋 Status & info rows

  • Slider Entity Row (⭐906) - Add a slider to adjust, e.g., the brightness of lights in lovelace entity cards (906★).

Dashboard Cards / 🎵 Media cards

  • Mini Media Player (⭐1.7k) - A minimalistic media player card (1,698★).

Dashboard Cards / 🌡️ Climate cards

  • Simple Thermostat (⭐807) - A simpler and more flexible thermostat card (807★).

Themes / 🖥️ Kiosk & wallpanel

  • Midnight - A dark theme by Marcel Hoffs.
  • Dark Cyan - A dark theme with cyan accents by Ryoen Deprouw.
  • Grey Night - A dark theme with grey accents by ksya.
  • Dark Red - A dark theme with red accents by Ryoen Deprouw.
  • Halloween - Pumpkins colored by Mahasri Kalavala.
  • Black and Green - A dark theme with pale green accents by GreenTurtwig.
  • Vintage - Give your frontend a vintage look with this theme by Anup Surendran.
  • Carbon Green - Light carbon theme with green accents by Reua.

Icon packs / 🖥️ Kiosk & wallpanel

  • Font Awesome Icons (⭐338) - Use the free icons from Font Awesome in your frontend (338★).

Apps / 📦 Third Party Apps

  • InfluxDB (⭐194) - Scalable datastore for metrics, events, and real-time analytics (194★).
  • Grafana (⭐275) - Open platform for beautiful analytics and monitoring (275★).
  • zigbee2mqtt (⭐15k) - Zigbee to MQTT bridge, get rid of your proprietary Zigbee bridges (15,106★).
  • TasmoAdmin (⭐253) - Centrally manage all your Sonoff-Tasmota devices (253★).
  • Log Viewer (⭐94) - Browser-based live log viewing utility (94★).
  • Tautulli (⭐46) - Monitor and get statistics from your Plex server (46★).
  • motionEye (⭐331) - Simple, elegant and feature-rich CCTV/NVR for your cameras (331★).
  • Traccar (⭐158) - Modern GPS tracking platform (158★).
  • Hass.io Google Drive Backup (⭐3.5k) - A complete and easy-to-configure solution for backing up to Google Drive (3,537★).

DIY / 🧩 Standalone projects

  • ESPHome - Program ESP8266 boards and ESP32 boards using YAML.

DIY / 🌉 DIY Gateways

  • OpenMQTTGateway (⭐4k) - A flexible MQTT gateway for IR, RF, BLE, MiFlora, SMS, and many sensors (4,010★).
  • esp8266 Milight Hub (⭐1k) - Alternative hub for Milight/LimitlessLED devices that uses MQTT (1,027★).

DIY / 🔨 DIY Projects

  • HA SwitchPlate - LCD Touchscreen wall switch replacement.
  • $10 WiFi RGB Bulb - An inexpensive RGB bulb that works on WiFi.
  • 433mhz/IR Bidirectional Gateway - Bidirectional with IR and 433mhz using ESP8266 and MQTT.
  • esp8266MQTTBlinds - Automate your window blinds using an ESP8266, a servo and MQTT.
  • Home Assistant's Hackster.io - A Hackster channel with multiple DIY projects.
  • Bed Presence Detection - ESP8266 based Bed Presence Detection.

Tools & Utilities / 🔨 DIY Projects

  • HASS Configurator (⭐335) - Browser-based configuration file editor (335★).
  • HA-Dockermon (⭐291) - A Node.js service for RESTful switches to control Docker containers (291★).
  • Home Assistant Device Database - Database of supported/confirmed working devices.
  • Jinja Scripts for Curious Minds (⭐273) - Bunch of Jinja2 scripts helping you to understand it better.
  • Monitor (⭐2.1k) - Distributed advertisement-based BTLE presence detection reported via MQTT (2,101★).
  • HASS-data-detective (⭐204) - Explore and analyse your database data (204★).
  • ADB Intents - List of ADB intents to control Android Devices.
  • Home Assistant Config Helper for VSCode - Visual Studio Code Extension that provides auto-completion, config validation and snippets when editing your configuration.
  • Mi Flora via MQTT daemon (⭐623) - Collect and transfer Xiaomi Mi Flora plant sensor data via MQTT (624★).

Online Resources / ✍️ Blogs

  • DIY Futurism - Brad posts articles with great instructions for new users.
  • Smart Home Hobby - Features budget friendly guides and information.
  • Self Hosted Home - Articles on DIY home automation projects and self hosted services.
  • Tinkering with Home Automation - Tinkerer's blog and guides.
  • HomeTechHacker - DIY Smarthome guides, reviews, and advice.
  • Intermittent Technology - Quindor's personal blog for pasting random (mostly technology related) things.

Online Resources / 📺 YouTube Channels

  • BurnsHA - Great informational and tutorial videos.
  • The Hook Up - Tutorials and more, also has videos on home automation in general.
  • JuanMTech - Easy to follow how-to videos, product reviews and more.
  • vCloudInfo - Publishes videos based on his home and GitHub repository.
  • digiblurDIY - Tutorials on hardware projects and Tasmota automations.
  • Intermit.Tech - Tutorials & reviews: Camera's, Home Networking, ESP8266 boards, Node-RED.

Online Resources / 🎙️ Podcasts

  • Home Assistant Podcast - Biweekly podcast with the latest news and interesting guests.

Online Resources / 📱 Social

  • @home_assistant - Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.
  • @hass_devs - Latest news on the development of Home Assistant for contributors.
  • @balloob - Founder of the Home Assistant project.
  • @pvizeli - Core developer and creator of the Home Assistant Supervisor.
  • @frenck - Creator of this Awesome list and maintainer of the Home Assistant Community Apps project.
  • @ccostan - Blogger of all things Tech. Smart Home, #IOT & other Geeky subjects.
  • @HomeTechHacker - Guy friends call when #tech happens. Tweet 25-50x/week about #smarthome, #homenetwork, #cybersecurity, #Linux, #gadgets, and #life.
  • @hassioaddons - For all community app news and updates.
  • @Dr_Zzs - Great how-to videos and also streams live.

Alternative Home Automation Software / 📱 Social

  • openHAB - Java-based and aims at being a universal integration platform.
  • Domoticz (⭐3.7k) - A lightweight Home Automation System (3,751★).
  • SmartThings - Commercial home automation hub by Samsung.

Other Awesome Lists / 📱 Social

  • awesome-iot (⭐3.9k) - Curated list of awesome Internet of Things projects and resources (3,928★).
entry.summary: 82 awesome projects updated on Sep 30 - Oct 06, 2019
